maria (partnerships): Quick sync — ACME wants to onboard via daily CSV dumps instead of streaming events. We need to confirm idempotency/dedupe strategy for marketplace usage. Short check-in? :wave:
ashish (billing): If they're doing CSVs we either need a unique per-row id or we compute a stable fingerprint. Are these full re-exports or incremental?
tess (partner-eng): They said daily full dumps occasionally, and incremental usually. Re-exports happen when they re-run the job, so duplicates are likely. They can add a row UUID but might take a week.
joel (ingest): For stream we require event_id + seq_no. For CSV we can accept row_id or fall back to SHA256 of (customer_id|timestamp|sku|units). If fallback used, we need a TTL dedupe window (e.g., 90 days) and careful float normalization.
nashish (billing): Also need to map usages to entitlement keys. If the same usage comes later via stream, we should have a deterministic precedence. Otherwise billing double-counts.
maria (partnerships): Proposal: canonical partner_usage_id — prefer explicit event_id/row_id when present. If absent, generate fingerprint. Precedence: stream > csv-row-id > csv-fingerprint. OK?
tess (partner-eng): Sounds fine. Can we ask them to include an "export_id" column so we can correlate dumps? Also request compressed CSVs (gzip) to save transfer.
joel (ingest): Implementation sketch:
```
# dedupe key resolution
if event_id:
    key = f"{partner_id}:event:{event_id}"
elif row_id:
    key = f"{partner_id}:row:{row_id}"
else:
    fp = sha256(customer_id + '|' + iso_ts + '|' + sku + '|' + normalized_units)
    key = f"{partner_id}:fingerprint:{fp}"
# store key with ttl=90d, only upsert if incoming ts > stored ts
```
We should persist last_seen_export_id per partner so we can detect full re-exports and backfill windows.
ashish (billing): Billing side: ensure invoice generation dedups by partner_usage_id. Also add a `source_priority` config per partner (values: stream,csv) so ops can override precedence for special cases.
maria (partnerships): Action items: joel to prototype dedupe store + fingerprint generator by EOD Friday; ashish to update billing mapping docs and invoice dedupe checklist; tess to ask ACME for row_id + export_id and confirm cadence. I'll schedule a 15m sync Wednesday. :calendar:
ingest-bot: deploy-check: lint ok, unit tests failing on csv float parsing (investigating) :wrench:
joel (ingest): noted, will push WIP PR and drop link here when ready :+1:
tess (partner-eng): I'll ping them today and paste sample schema request here.
maria (partnerships): Thanks team :heart: We'll regroup Wed.
